definition: The Paper-I common-window rule is applied independently to insertion SNAKE versus Append-ADAPT and append-only SNAKE versus Append-ADAPT. Weak-strong and strong-strong instead use explicit insertion plateau anchors k=9 and k=11, with Append-ADAPT taken at its first crossing of the anchored insertion error. Insertion endpoint costs are reported independently.
